replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I can feel some anxiety when dealing with complex equations or proofs, especially if they seem too abstract for me. But I try to break them down into simpler parts to manage this feeling.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: In my last year of high school, I used an online AI tutor that helped me with practice problems and explanations. It made learning more interactive and less intimidating for me.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the quadratic equation in the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0. Then, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)] / (2a). Make sure to check your solutions by plugging them back into the original equation.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative of f(x) and set it equal to zero: f'(x) = 0. Solve for x to get critical points. Then, check if these are maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
